reason: This is framed as a refactor, but it moves the base physical-plan abstraction at the center of planner internals and touches many high-blast-radius paths: optimizer, physical plans, task selection, cost models, stats, index resolution, plan cloning, and plan-to-PB. A broad package move across these files is central enough to planner correctness that it can hide Blocker/High regressions even without obvious feature changes.
